statusLine.command: input=$(cat); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); used=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty'); five=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.rate_limits.five_hour.used_percentage // empty'); week=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.rate_limits.seven_day.used_percentage // empty'); effort=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.effort.level // empty'); out=$(printf '\033[01;36m%s\033[00m' "$model"); [ -n "$effort" ] && out="$out | effort: $effort"; [ -n "$used" ] && out="$out | ctx: $(printf '%.0f' "$used")% used"; [ -n "$five" ] && out="$out | 5h: $(printf '%.0f' "$five")%"; [ -n "$week" ] && out="$out | 7d: $(printf '%.0f' "$week")%"; echo "$out"
